recorder_retention.title: Keep more mower history
recorder_retention.description: The recorder keeps {days} days of history (recorder: purge_keep_days in configuration.yaml). This integration's entities are the mower's whole record: every position, task reading, state report and status poll. Keep {suggested} days or more if the record should outlast a short absence; an application that reads the mower's history from Home Assistant can go back no further than the recorder keeps. Ignore this if {days} days is what you want.
